title: Seed3D 2.0: ByteDance's Production-Ready 3D Foundation Model
summary: Seed3D 2.0 is a state-of-the-art generative model for creating high-fidelity 3D assets with physically-based rendering (PBR) textures. It utilizes a coarse-to-fine DiT architecture and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) scaling to produce simulation-ready models suitable for robotics and industrial workflows.
research_notes: Achieved significant performance leads over Hunyuan3D and Tripo in geometric precision; available via ByteDance's Volcano Engine API.

evolution.summary: Evolved from Seed3D 1.0 by transitioning to a two-stage DiT pipeline and MoE-based material engine. It added support for URDF export for robotics simulation, functional part decomposition, and scene-level generation capabilities.
